headline: US Treasury Reports $261 Billion Net Foreign Capital Inflow in September
summary: The U.S. Treasury reported a net TIC inflow of $261.0 billion in September 2026, covering foreign acquisitions of long-term and short-term securities and banking flows.
why: TIC data provides a window into foreign demand for US assets, which is crucial for understanding the financing of the US current account deficit and the strength of the dollar.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: Strong foreign capital inflows generally support the value of the domestic currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Large capital inflows indicate strong international demand for US-denominated assets, which typically strengthens the dollar and supports bond prices.
